panels.title: 🥇 TANGIBLE-VALUE LADDER — gold › BTC › ETH › alts
Haven state
panels.description: Where capital sits on the tangibility ladder. FLIGHT_TO_QUALITY = money moving DOWN the ladder toward what is real (fear); RISK_ON = reaching up for beta (froth); UNKNOWN = too few rungs to say. Report-only — it sizes nothing.

defaults.noValue: ⚠ no series — exporter/pusher, not the bot

panels.title: Gradient
panels.description: Mean spread between ADJACENT rungs, % over 24h. POSITIVE = the more tangible rung is outperforming (fear travelling down the ladder); negative = the reach for beta. Adjacent-only so one blown-out microcap cannot write a headline about gold.

panels.title: Rungs read
panels.description: How many of the four rungs had usable bars this scrape (PAXG/BTC/ETH/ALT). Fewer than two adjacent = UNKNOWN, a state rather than a guessed zero.

panels.title: Return by rung (24h %)
panels.description: The ladder itself: gold (a bar in a vault) › BTC (a network with a security budget) › ETH (a platform contingent on usage) › alts (venture bets). The ALT rung is AVERAGED so one coin ripping is not a regime.

panels.title: Gradient over time — is fear travelling down the ladder?
panels.description: The trend is the read: a gradient climbing through zero is capital rotating toward tangibility ahead of a drawdown; falling through zero is risk appetite returning. Sustained direction matters, not the current print. Empty means: no haven ladder read yet.

options.content:
**THALES** is the bot's footprint & manipulation-defense layer — evidence-weighted detectors that shade sizing when a book looks *engineered* rather than organic. Every score is **0–1** (higher = more suspicious) and **reliability-weighted**: a detector only bites once it has proven itself on realized outcomes (Wilson-LCB), so it can't cry wolf.

- **grid / metronome / clockwork** — periodicity footprints: grid-bot ladders, fixed-interval refills, time-of-day algo seasonality.
- **stop-zone** — proximity to round-number stop clusters (stop-hunt zones).
- **bar-close** — order-flow clustering at bar closes.
- **spoof bid / ask** — flicker: large levels that appear then vanish without the mid ever crossing (**TH-017**).
- **feed dirty / lapses / bar holes** — feed integrity; a dirty feed is quarantined, never traded.

THALES **never triggers a trade** — it only *attenuates*: shade the size, or down-weight that row in learning (a painted book teaches the painter's lesson, not the market's).

panels.title: THALES detector scorecard (higher = more suspicious)
panels.description: Per-asset footprint scores (0-1) + feed-integrity counters. THALES only ATTENUATES (shade size / down-weight the training row) — it never triggers a trade.

panels.title: Spoof-flicker pressure (bid)
panels.description: TH-017 spoof EWMA per asset — higher = a book being painted; THALES shades size there. Wall-time normalized 2026-07-29: the score no longer depends on poll cadence, only on the spoofer's actual flip rate.

defaults.noValue: no THALES read for this asset

panels.title: Stop-hunt zone proximity
panels.description: Proximity to round-number stop clusters per asset. 2026-07-29 recalibration: the geometric base rate (tolerance band / magnet spacing) is now subtracted, so a random mark reads ~0 — before this the gauge sat at 0.4-0.5 everywhere the price grid was fine (43% of history >0.5 with zero PnL discrimination). A high reading now means the mark is genuinely AT a magnet.

defaults.noValue: no THALES read for this asset

panels.title: Manipulation suspicion
panels.description: Parameter-free max of the manipulation footprints per asset.

panels.title: Detector reliability — lift over base rate (earning its keep)
panels.description: THALES V2 vindication ledger (2026-07-29 unlock): every closed model-lane trade grades the detectors that advised on its entry — in SHADOW mode too, so this is the promotion-to-advise evidence accruing live. Weight = the detector's Wilson-LCB win/loss lift over the base rate below (0 = no proven edge over just knowing the base rate; the shade gain scales by it in advise mode). Empty table = ledger still accruing its first min_fired=20 grades per detector.

panels.title: Graded closes
panels.description: Closed trades graded into the THALES reliability ledger (the __base__ null's sample size). Started counting 2026-07-29 — was structurally stuck at 0 before (grading was advise-gated while promotion required shadow evidence).

panels.title: Base win rate
panels.description: Win rate across ALL graded closes — the null each detector must BEAT to earn shade weight ('up' advice vs this, 'down' advice vs its complement). The 2026-07-29 correction replaced the old 0.5 coin-flip null that muted honest detectors on a ~16%-win stream.
